options.name: Adhesive
options.benefit: +4 on disarm and grapple combat maneuver checks.

options.name: Bite Attack
options.benefit: Gain a primary bite attack dealing 1d4 damage (1d3 Small).

options.name: Claws
options.benefit: Gain two primary claw attacks dealing 1d4 damage each (1d3 Small).

options.name: Elongated Fingers
options.benefit: Increase reach by 5 feet for melee touch attacks.

options.name: Elongated Legs
options.benefit: Increase base movement speed by 10 feet.

options.name: Energy Resistance
options.benefit: Gain energy resistance 5 to a selected energy type; this mutation can be selected repeatedly.
